conditions.rule: Beacon v1 has been publicly released as a downloadable artifact, not merely planned, promised, or privately tested.
An independent build of Beacon v1 has completed and reproduced the published artifact byte for byte.
A completed Beacon v1 restoration exercise recovered every archived record without any missing or corrupted record.
The restored Beacon v1 archive passed a completed integrity verification against its original manifest.
The recipient operations team has explicitly accepted responsibility for operating Beacon v1 after a completed handover.
The recipient operations team has completed a rehearsal using the Beacon v1 runbook without assistance from the authors.
